annotations.text:
Option A — Refined tabs (your current layout, polished)
Top stat cards + horizontal tabs. Lowest-risk, nothing to relearn.
Trade-off: the tab row gets crowded as you add more sections.

Option B — Left sidebar (modern SaaS)
Vertical nav scales to many sections; more room for content.
Trade-off: a bigger visual change from today.

Option C — Overview home (dashboard-first)
Lands on a greeting + key metrics + quick actions + recent activity, instead of dropping straight into a tab.
Trade-off: one extra click to reach a specific list.

Option D — Focused & minimal
Calm single column, one big Create-test action, roomy list.
Trade-off: secondary tools live behind a menu.
